_description: Tracks improvement scores across automated cycles.

cycles.root_cause: Broad economic queries ('show me economic data', 'how is the economy doing') triggered generic clarification ('which indicator?') because the semantic clarifier didn't recognize these as a broad concept category. Unlike 'employment', 'debt', 'trade' etc. which had structured profiles, 'economic data/indicators/economy' had no profile.
cycles.fix_description: Added 'broad_economic_concept' profile to SemanticClarifier with trigger patterns for 'economic data', 'economic indicators', 'economy doing' and block patterns for specific indicators (GDP, inflation, etc.). Options: GDP (economic output), inflation rate (price stability), unemployment rate (labor market).
cycles.note: Reliability stays at 33% (clarification still happens, but now with HELPFUL options). This is correct behavior — vague queries SHOULD clarify, just with better options. mc-02 regressed to 1 series (LLM non-determinism). acc-11 IMF debt-to-GDP passes.
